groups.title: Team Avatar
groups.def: Aang's core group as the show and the wiki's member list define it: Aang, Katara, Sokka, Toph, Zuko (joins in "The Western Air Temple"), Suki (joins in "The Boiling Rock, Part 2") and the animals Appa and Momo. Haru, The Duke and Pipsqueak, whom the wiki lists as temporary members after the invasion, allies who stay at the Western Air Temple (Hakoda, Chit Sang) and the White Lotus in the finale don't count; the groups that can deal Haru, The Duke or Pipsqueak next to this one are in avoid.

groups.title: Firebenders
groups.def: Every character shown firebending on screen, Avatars included: Aang (from Book 3) and Roku (3x06, and through Aang against Zhao in 1x08); Chit Sang firebends at the Boiling Rock (3x14), Combustion Man's combustion is a firebending technique, and Azulon is called a prodigy and his throne-room flames flare with his anger (2x07). Out: Lo and Li (they tell Azula they aren't firebenders, 3x20), Lu Ten (never bends on screen), nonbenders Ursa, Mai, Ty Lee, Piandao and the warden, and Kyoshi, Kuruk and Yangchen, never shown firebending but arguable because the Avatar masters all four elements, so every group that can deal them or Lu Ten next to this one is in avoid.

groups.title: Fire Nation Royal Family
groups.def: Every member of the Fire Nation's ruling family by birth or marriage who is shown or named on screen, through Zuko's generation: Sozin, his son Azulon, Azulon's sons Iroh and Ozai, Ozai's wife Ursa, their children Zuko and Azula, and Iroh's son Lu Ten. Roku is Ursa's grandfather but was never royal; Lo and Li are Azula's advisers, not family.

groups.title: Animals
groups.def: Every animal character (a real creature, not a spirit or a human): Appa, Momo, June's shirshu Nyla, the Earth King's bear Bosco and Kyoshi Island's unagi ("unagi" is its species, not a personal name, so the group isn't "named" animals). Spirits in animal form (Hei Bai, Wan Shi Tong, Koh) are out and "Spirits" is in avoid; the Earth Rumble wrestlers with animal ring names are humans.

groups.title: Waterbenders
groups.def: Every character shown waterbending on screen, Avatars included: Aang, Roku (3x06) and Kuruk (2x01, 3x19), plus Katara, Pakku, Hama (and her bloodbending) and the Foggy Swamp benders Huu (plantbending), Tho and Due. Out: Kya (a nonbender who only claims to be the waterbender to save Katara), Kanna, Hakoda, Sokka, Yue (a nonbender in life, but as the Moon Spirit, and "the moon was the first waterbender" (3x08), she's arguable) and Kyoshi and Yangchen, never shown waterbending but Avatars; every group that can deal Yue, Kyoshi or Yangchen next to this one is in avoid ("Spirits" and "Water Tribe" list this group).

groups.title: Order of the White Lotus
groups.def: Named members of the secret Order of the White Lotus who liberate Ba Sing Se in the finale.

groups.title: Freedom Fighters
groups.def: Official members of Jet's band of Earth Kingdom resistance fighters.

groups.title: Earthbenders
groups.def: Every character shown earthbending on screen, Avatars included (Aang; Roku in 3x06; Kyoshi in 2x01, 2x05 and 3x19): Toph, Bumi, Haru, Long Feng, Earth Rumble host Xin Fu and all six Earth Rumble VI wrestlers (Fire Nation Man is an earthbender with a Fire Nation stage persona). Out: nonbenders Lao and Poppy Beifong, and Kuruk and Yangchen, never shown earthbending but arguable because the Avatar masters all four elements, so the groups that can deal them next to this one are in avoid ("Waterbenders" lists this group).

groups.title: Fire Lords
groups.def: Characters crowned Fire Lord on screen: Sozin, Azulon, Ozai and Zuko (crowned in the finale); Iroh was only crown prince. Azula is named Fire Lord by Ozai and calls herself Fire Lord, but her coronation is stopped (the wiki's list leaves her out); since that's arguable, "Wore Kyoshi Warrior makeup", the only group that can deal Azula next to this one, is in avoid.

groups.title: Katara and Sokka's Family
groups.def: Katara and Sokka's family as shown on screen: their grandmother Kanna, parents Hakoda and Kya, and Pakku, who marries Kanna and becomes their step-grandfather ("how about a hug for your new grandfather?" / "Welcome to the family, Gramp-Gramp!", 3x19).

groups.title: Sword Fighters
groups.def: Characters shown fighting with a sword on screen: Sokka (the sword Piandao trains him with), Zuko's dual dao, Jet's hook swords, Piandao, and Suki's katana against Azula. Knives and daggers (Mai, Smellerbee, Azula's knife), war fans (Kyoshi) and spears or clubs (The Duke, Pipsqueak) don't count.

groups.title: Water Tribe
groups.def: Characters from the Northern or Southern Water Tribe: Katara, Sokka, Kanna, Hakoda, Kya, Pakku, Yue, Hama and Kuruk (the Northern Water Tribe Avatar, 3x19). The Foggy Swamp benders Huu, Tho and Due live in the Earth Kingdom and the show never ties them to the Water Tribes (Tho didn't know there were waterbenders outside the swamp; their Water Tribe roots come from DVD commentary), so they're out, and "Waterbenders" and "Team Avatar's invasion allies", which carry them, are in avoid.

groups.title: Avatars
groups.def: Every Avatar who appears: Aang and the four past lives shown on screen, Roku, Kyoshi, Kuruk and Yangchen ("Past Avatars" was misleading with Aang in it).

groups.title: Spirits
groups.def: Spirit-world beings Koh, Wan Shi Tong and Hei Bai, plus Yue, who becomes the Moon Spirit. The past Avatars appear to Aang as spirits but are his past lives, not Spirit World beings; since that's arguable, every group that can deal Roku, Kyoshi, Kuruk or Yangchen next to this one is in avoid, and "Waterbenders" is too (Yue as the Moon Spirit). Iroh only becomes a spirit in Korra.

groups.title: At the Boiling Rock
groups.def: Everyone seen at the Boiling Rock prison in the two-part "The Boiling Rock": the warden, the inmates Suki, Hakoda and Chit Sang, Sokka and Zuko (undercover), and Azula, Mai and Ty Lee, who arrive in Part 2. The rest of Team Avatar stays at the Western Air Temple.

groups.title: Agni Kai Fighters
groups.def: Characters confirmed to have fought an on-screen Agni Kai duel. Only three are depicted, and Zuko fights in all of them.

groups.title: Earth Rumble Contestants
groups.def: Everyone who fights in the Earth Rumble VI tournament in "The Blind Bandit" (2x06): The Boulder, The Hippo, Fire Nation Man, The Gopher, The Gecko and Headhunter, champion Toph (the Blind Bandit) and Aang, who takes host Xin Fu's open challenge. Xin Fu is the host and referee (he only fights Toph later, at the ransom exchange), so he's out; his only other group, "Earthbenders", can't share a board with this one.

groups.title: No Real Name Given
groups.def: Characters known only by a job title, an Earth Rumble ring name or a nickname others give them, with no personal name ever said on screen: the cabbage merchant ("Cai" comes from a 2024 book), Combustion Man (Sokka's nickname; Zuko knows his real name but never says it), the Mechanist, the Boiling Rock warden, The Boulder, Fire Nation Man, Headhunter, The Hippo, The Gecko and The Gopher. Jet introduces "Smellerbee, The Duke and Pipsqueak" as names ("You think my name is funny?"), so the Freedom Fighters are out, and the unagi is a species; "Freedom Fighters", "Team Avatar's invasion allies" and "Animals" are in avoid.

groups.title: Team Avatar's invasion allies
groups.def: Named characters outside Team Avatar who take part in the Day of Black Sun invasion force: Hakoda, Haru, The Duke, Pipsqueak, The Boulder, The Hippo, the Mechanist and the swamp waterbenders Huu, Due and Tho. Team Avatar's own members aren't counted; Bumi freeing Omashu and Iroh breaking out of prison during the eclipse don't count; Suki is in the Boiling Rock at the time.

groups.title: Generated or redirected lightning
groups.def: Characters shown generating or redirecting lightning on screen: Azula, Iroh (2x09) and Ozai generate it; Iroh, Zuko (3x11, 3x20) and Aang (against Ozai in the finale) redirect it. Titled this way because Zuko and Aang never generate lightning. Combustion Man's blasts and Sozin drawing heat out of lava (3x06) don't count.

groups.title: Starred in a Tale of Ba Sing Se
groups.def: Characters who get their own segment in "The Tales of Ba Sing Se" (Toph and Katara share one). Appa's story is the following episode, "Appa's Lost Days", so he doesn't count.

groups.title: Wore Kyoshi Warrior makeup
groups.def: Characters seen in the Kyoshi Warriors' face paint and green armor: Suki, Sokka (training with them in "The Warriors of Kyoshi"), Azula, Mai and Ty Lee (disguised as the warriors in Ba Sing Se; Ty Lee later joins for real), and Avatar Kyoshi, whose own look the uniform copies.

groups.title: Team Avatar's parents
groups.def: Parents of a Team Avatar member who appear or are named on screen: Hakoda and Kya (Katara and Sokka), Lao and Poppy Beifong (Toph), Ozai and Ursa (Zuko). Aang's and Suki's parents never appear; uncle Iroh and grandmother Kanna aren't parents.

groups.title: Siblings
groups.def: Characters shown or stated on screen to have a brother or sister: Katara and Sokka, Zuko and Azula, Iroh and Ozai, Mai (baby brother Tom-Tom), Ty Lee (six identical sisters) and the twin sisters Lo and Li. Siblings that exist only in comics or novels (Sozin's, Roku's, Zhao's) don't count, and Hama's "my brothers and sisters" means her fellow waterbenders. The Boiling Rock warden is only called Mai's uncle on screen, so the groups that carry him ("At the Boiling Rock", "No Real Name Given") are in avoid.

groups.title: Aang's bending teachers
groups.def: Characters who teach Aang a bending art on screen: Katara and Pakku (water), Toph (earth), Jeong Jeong and Zuko (fire). Bumi explains "neutral jing" but tells Aang to find a different earthbending teacher (2x03); Guru Pathik teaches chakras, not bending; the past Avatars only give advice.

groups.title: Dead before the show begins
groups.def: Characters already dead when the series opens, seen only in flashbacks or as spirits: Kya, Lu Ten, Sozin, Azulon and Aang's four past lives. Ursa is alive (banished); Jet, Yue and Zhao are lost during the series.
